notes.title: Buissons february 8th update - fixes and changes
notes.content:
First update for Buissons
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions of bushes and hunter's bullet
[*] Decreased storm occurrences in normal forest, but increased number of lightning bolts
[*] Slightly increased hunter's rotation speed
[*] Fewer bushes on the edges of the forest
[*] The birdz no longer arise on the screen unless it is on a player
[*] Birdz controlled by players can no longer get stuck to a player's bush
[*] Increase of the size and speed of the ball over time
[/ list]
Thank you for the welcome you gave to Buissons. Further fixes are to come.
